post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As the Merlin, I was unable to effectively coordinate and communicate with the Good team, ultimately leading to our downfall. My strategy was flawed, and I did not make the most of the information available to me throughout the game. Improving my critical thinking and decision-making skills will be crucial in future games.

player_observations.Charlie: Charlie demonstrated exceptional leadership and strategic thinking, consistently making effective decisions and executing missions with precision.
player_observations.Bob: Bob played the Evil role flawlessly, always managing to sabotage the Good team's missions while appearing to be a valuable member of their team.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's performance as the Assassin was underwhelming, failing to significantly impact the game despite having opportunities to eliminate key targets. Her actions seemed random and lacked a clear strategy.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, who initially seemed like a strong leader, struggled to adjust to the loss of key team members, ultimately contributing to our team's failure. She could benefit from learning how to adapt to changing circumstances.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I executed my plans effectively, using my influence to disrupt the good team's efforts without being caught by Merlin. However, I could improve by being more proactive in mission 1, where I could have used my power to prevent the good team from succeeding. I relied on others to make mistakes in several missions.

player_observations.Charlie: Charlie showed good instincts as a leader, but often made the same mistake by trusting his teammates blindly. He could have investigated further before making critical decisions.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was a valuable addition to the team, but she struggled with making tough choices. She often took too long to weigh her options, allowing me to influence the outcome.
player_observations.Eve: Eve performed well as the assassin, but her lack of communication made it difficult for her to align her efforts with mine. She could have worked more closely with me to achieve our goals.
player_observations.Alice: Alice was a formidable opponent as Merlin, but her inability to deceive me consistently limited our team's chances. She could have experimented with more creative ways to disguise her identity and actions.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully completed mission 1 with no failures and demonstrated good teamwork skills, but overall failed to win the game by not correctly identifying the assassin or preventing other missions from failing.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played the role of Merlin effectively, often suggesting missions that I participated in and seemed to prioritize success over risk, but her lack of participation in Mission 2 was unexpected.
player_observations.Bob: Bob consistently participated in high-stakes missions and ultimately proved to be the traitor, but I didn't receive enough information to identify him before the game ended.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's role as a good player was evident in her participation in Missions 2 and 3, showing that she understood the importance of high-stakes missions, but like me, she couldn't catch up to Bob's deception.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played the role of the assassin well, successfully eliminating one good player, and I didn't get the chance to target her until the very end, which was too late to change the game's outcome.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: Although I had a strong start as the leader of mission 1 and correctly assessed the roles, I made pivotal mistakes in missions 2 and 5 by trusting Bob and overestimating the team's overall chances of success, ultimately contributing to the team's downfall.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played her Merlin role perfectly, using her ability to reveal the FAIL card when necessary, and providing crucial information to the team. However, her role could have been more effective with better distribution of knowledge and team collaboration.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's playstyle was very stealthy, and his ability to deceive even the most skilled players was impressive. His subtle moves were key to the team's victory, as he managed to gain our trust and ultimately seal our fate.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a crucial role as the leader and was instrumental in the success of mission 1. However, his overconfidence in trusting Eve and Alice led to mission 2's failure, and his inability to rectify the situation led to our overall defeat.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's Assassin role was incredibly effective, as she was able to gain positions of power and influence the flow of the game without raising any suspicion. Her cunning nature and ability to eliminate threats quickly made her a formidable opponent.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I performed well at identifying and killing the good heroes without being detected, but my biggest improvement would be being more discreet in revealing my intentions through innocent card plays.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played a very subtle Merlin, consistently pretending to be an innocent member of the opposing team while actually providing crucial guidance to the other good heroes.
